messages:
sylvie-docs: quick pass on the quickstart found a few small but perennial footguns: HTTPie example uses REDWOOD_KEY and the header syntax is wrong for PowerShell users; Java sample in /examples uses an old builder API; and the top page still implies curl will retry (it doesn't). opening a small PR to fix.

ben-sdks: thanks for catching. which Java constructor is breaking?

sylvie-docs: examples/java/Quickstart.java  it still shows `new RedwoodClientBuilder().withApiKey(REDWOOD_KEY).build()` which fails on current sdk v2.x. new API is `RedwoodClient.create(apiKey)`. also changing env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere.

owen-support: we get ~5-8 support tickets /month from the env var mismatch. happy to update KB once docs land. can you paste the corrected Java snippet here?

sylvie-docs: pasted the proposed Java snippet for review:

```java
// Java (sdk v2+) - simple sync example
import com.redwood.client.RedwoodClient;
import com.redwood.client.GenerateRequest;

public class Quickstart {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    String apiKey = System.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY");
    RedwoodClient client = RedwoodClient.create(apiKey);
    var resp = client.generate(new GenerateRequest.Builder().prompt("Hello").build());
    System.out.println(resp.getText());
  }
}
```

maya-devex: looks good. for HTTPie and curl we should also add a tiny PowerShell note so people don't run into header interpolation issues. HTTPie corrected example: `http POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate Authorization:"Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" prompt='Hello'` is fine for bash but blows up in PS.

ben-sdks: can you include a PowerShell-safe HTTPie/curl example? good to have both.

sylvie-docs: added both below:

```bash
# HTTPie (bash)
http POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate Authorization:"Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" prompt='Hello'
```

```pwsh
# HTTPie (PowerShell) - use $env: to avoid interpolation
http POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate Authorization:"Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" prompt='Hello'
```

```pwsh
# curl (PowerShell)
curl -Method POST -Uri 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate' -Headers @{ 'Authorization' = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" } -Body (ConvertTo-Json @{ prompt = 'Hello' })
```

owen-support: perfect. one more ask: add a single-line callout near the top: "Note: official SDKs include retry/backoff; CLI/httpie/curl examples do not automatically retry." avoids assumptions.

maya-devex: also file a small docs-ui ticket to add copy buttons and a runtime selector (Node/Java/Python toggle) so users get the snippet that matches their environment. I'll add it to the quickstart follow-ups.

sylvie-docs: opened PR with these edits + a follow-up UI issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1337 (ui: copy buttons & runtime selector).

build-bot: docs build queued (job 11842). ETA ~ 7m.

ben-sdks: after merge I'll update the Java SDK changelog reminding maintainers to update quickstart examples when we change public constructors.

owen-support: i'll batch-close the pending tickets once the site rebuilds. thanks for the tidy patch.

sylvie-docs: thanks everyone thumbsup; will close after merge.
